ASSET TAGGING SYSTEM

Make every important tool easy to identify.

Create a clear asset ID and QR label, then scan it to see its current location and every recorded handoff.

Create your first label →

A tag turns a tool into a record your crew can use.

Fieldmark combines an asset ID with a QR label. The label makes the physical item fast to identify; the record explains who has it, where it was last moved, and whether it needs attention.

Clear labels

Use a unique identifier that works in the shop and on the job site.

Phone scanning

Open the tool record through the camera in a standard browser.

History, not just a tag

Every scan action can contribute to an accountable chain of custody.

Start with the tools that move most

You do not need to tag every consumable on day one. Begin with high-value or often-borrowed tools, import the list, and add labels as your crew adopts the workflow.
